records.title: Sports Infrastructure in Sixth Schedule Districts of Assam
details: a to d: This Ministry has sanctioned nine sports infrastructure projects under Khelo India Scheme and three sport infrastructure projects under NSDF in the State of Assam.

records.title: Maintenance and Operation of NH-9
details: मैं उसकी इन्क्वायरी करके उस पर कार्रवाई करूंगा। मैं इनसे अनुरोध करूंगा कि क्वेश्चन ऑवर समाप्त होने के बाद आप मेरे ऑफिस में आइए। वहां कंसर्निंग ऑफिसर्स भी आते हैं। मैं आपको तुरंत उसकी जानकारी भी दूंगा और कुछ करना होगा, तो प्रॉब्लम सॉल्व कर दूंगा।

records.title: Electrification under DDUGJY and RDSS in Karbi Anglong
details:
a to b): Till date, electrification works for 13.59 lakh households have been sanctioned under RDSS including 9,011 and 2,604 households in the districts of Karbi Anglong and Dima Hasao respectively.
 In addition, till date, under New Solar Power scheme, works amounting to Rs 50 Cr have been sanctioned for off-grid solar based electrification for 9961 households.
